name: mac-updater
title: Mac Updater
description: Apply every update on your Mac from one place — not just check for them. Upgrades Homebrew casks & formulae, Mac App Store apps, and Sparkle / Electron / GitHub apps in place (download, verify code signature, swap, roll back on failure), plus npm, pip, and Ruby gem globals. Adopt unmanaged apps into Homebrew with one click so they become updatable too. Nothing updates silently unless you turn on the optional background job.
author: Ouseph

commands.name: mac-updater
commands.title: Mac Updater
commands.subtitle: Apply every update, one place
commands.description: Review and apply updates for every app and package on your Mac — Homebrew, App Store, Sparkle, Electron, GitHub, npm, pip, gems — and adopt unmanaged apps into Homebrew so they become updatable.

commands.name: update-everything
commands.title: Update Everything
commands.subtitle: Mac Updater
commands.description: Apply every available update in one run, with a live per-app progress queue across Homebrew, App Store, npm, pip, and gems.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Mac Updater Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Mac Updater
commands.description: Show a passive update count in the menu bar.

commands.name: auto-update
commands.title: Auto-Update in Background
commands.subtitle: Mac Updater
commands.description: Optionally apply updates on a schedule in the background. Off until you enable it; configure in command preferences.

preferences.name: enableBrew
preferences.label: Auto-update Homebrew (casks + formulae)
preferences.description: Runs brew upgrade --greedy quietly in the background.

preferences.name: enableMas
preferences.label: Auto-update Mac App Store apps
preferences.description: Runs mas upgrade quietly. Requires mas to be installed and a signed-in App Store.

preferences.name: quietHours
preferences.label: Skip between midnight and 7am
preferences.description: Avoid running updates while you're asleep.

preferences.name: notifyOnSuccess
preferences.label: Show a notification when something updates
preferences.description: Quietly HUDs when the background run upgrades anything.
